name: ace-vscode
description: Pattern learning and retrieval for GitHub Copilot - captures what works, retrieves it when needed

chatParticipants.name: ace
chatParticipants.description: Semantic pattern search and learning for your codebase

disambiguation.description: Questions about coding patterns, best practices, implementation approaches, or how to build something
examples: What's the best pattern for error handling?
What's the recommended approach for API design?

disambiguation.description: Capturing coding approaches, lessons learned, or insights after completing work
examples: Store this as a best practice

disambiguation.description: Finding solutions to known issues, gotchas, or common problems
examples: I'm getting a strange error with

commands.name: search
commands.description: Search for relevant patterns in the playbook

commands.name: learn
commands.description: Capture patterns from the current session

commands.name: domains
commands.description: List available domains with pattern counts

languageModelTools.name: ace_search
languageModelTools.modelDescription: MANDATORY: Search for proven coding patterns BEFORE implementing, building, fixing, or debugging. Returns battle-tested approaches, known gotchas, and best practices from the team's playbook. ALWAYS call this first when starting any coding task.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Search ACE playbook for relevant patterns

query.description: What to search for (e.g., 'authentication', 'error handling', 'API integration')

allowed_domains.description: Comma-separated list of domains to include (whitelist). Use /domains to discover available domains.

blocked_domains.description: Comma-separated list of domains to exclude (blacklist)

languageModelTools.name: ace_learn
languageModelTools.modelDescription: MANDATORY: Capture patterns from completed work. ALWAYS call this AFTER implementing features, fixing bugs, or discovering gotchas. Saves knowledge for future use - this is how the team learns and improves.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Capture patterns and lessons learned from work

task.description: Brief description of what was accomplished

output.description: Lessons learned, gotchas discovered, or key insights

languageModelTools.name: ace_status
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Show playbook statistics including total patterns, quality metrics, and section breakdown.

languageModelTools.name: ace_get_playbook
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Retrieve patterns from the playbook, optionally filtered by section or minimum helpful score.

section.description: Filter by section: strategies_and_hard_rules, useful_code_snippets, troubleshooting_and_pitfalls, apis_to_use

enumDescriptions: Smart suggestions based on activity patterns
Aggressive suggestions after any significant work
ace.automation.level.description: Automation level for ACE learning suggestions

ace.automation.minEditsBeforeSuggest.description: Minimum edits before suggesting learning capture

ace.automation.idleMinutesBeforeSuggest.description: Minutes of idle time before suggesting learning

ace.automation.showStatusBar.description: Show ACE status in the status bar

ace.automation.gitAutoCapture.description: Automatically suggest learning capture when commits are detected

ace.features.showQuotaWarnings.description: Show notifications when approaching quota limits (>80%)

ace.features.showUsageInStatusBar.description: Show usage percentage in status bar tooltip

scripts.pretest: npm run compile && npm run compile:tests
